title: Direction subspace of a quadratic system
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements. The associated direction subspace consists of the vectors $a$ of length $n^2$ for which the dot product of $a$ with every flattened coefficient matrix from $L$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
